The idea behind Offscript

A different perspective
can change your day.

Offscript is a space for honest conversations with artists, thinkers, makers, and people finding their own way.

Each week, host Alex Morgan follows a thread of curiosity. We talk about making things, paying attention, changing direction, and being a person in the world. Sometimes we find an answer. Usually, we find a better question.

No perfect answers.
Just good conversations.

New episodes arrive every Tuesday. Pick one that catches your eye, put on your headphones, and make yourself comfortable.

Offscript is a concept podcast. The episode collection includes original narrated audio previews.

The voice on the other side

Hi, I’m Alex.

I’m a writer, a professional question-asker, and the person behind Offscript. I’ve always thought the best conversations happen when we stop trying to have all the answers.

This show began with a notebook full of questions and a simple idea: sit down with interesting people, listen properly, and see where the conversation goes.

“My favorite question?
Tell me more about that.”

When I’m not recording, you’ll probably find me in a secondhand bookshop, on an unnecessarily long walk, or making a very deliberate cup of coffee.
